title: Padded clone value
statement: Let $E$ be a weighted constraint experiment with constraint template $[?]$ over variables $V$, and let $R$ be a uniform refinement of $E$. For natural numbers $r,M$, suppose every predicate selected by an outcome has arity at most $r$, and let $a:V\times\{0,\ldots,M-1\}\to D$ be an assignment. The padded clone value of $a$ is the expected padded clone payoff when a refined occurrence and a map from the $r$ positions to the $M$ clones are sampled.
